info.title: Confluence
info.description: Confluence is Atlassian's wiki and knowledge management platform. Create, read, and update pages, monitor spaces for changes with polling triggers, search content with CQL, and manage comments on Confluence Cloud.

get.summary: When a page is created or updated in a space
get.description: Returns pages in a Confluence space, sorted by modification date. Use as a polling trigger to detect new or updated pages.
get.x-ms-trigger-hint: To see it work, create or update a page in the selected space.

parameters.name: spaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Confluence space to watch.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order for pages. Default is by most recently modified.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by page status. Options: current, draft, trashed, archived.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results per page. Default is 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for pagination obtained from the previous response.

parameters.name: body-format
parameters.description: Format to return the body content. Options: storage, atlas_doc_format. Omit to exclude body.

200.description: A list of pages in the space.

get.summary: When a new comment is posted on a page
get.description: Returns footer comments on a specific Confluence page. Use as a polling trigger to detect new comments.
get.x-ms-trigger-hint: To see it work, post a comment on the selected page.

parameters.name: pageId
parameters.description: The ID of the page to get comments for.

parameters.name: body-format
parameters.description: Format to return the comment body. Options: storage, atlas_doc_format.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results per page. Default is 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for pagination obtained from the previous response.

200.description: A list of footer comments on the page.

get.description: Returns a specific Confluence page including its title, body content, version info, and links.

parameters.name: pageId
parameters.description: The ID of the page to retrieve.

parameters.name: body-format
parameters.description: Format to return the body content. Options: storage, atlas_doc_format, view.

parameters.name: include-labels
parameters.description: Include labels in the response. Default is false.

parameters.name: include-properties
parameters.description: Include content properties in the response. Default is false.

parameters.name: include-likes
parameters.description: Include like count in the response. Default is false.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Specific version number to retrieve. Default is the latest version.

put.description: Updates an existing Confluence page title, body, or status. Requires the current version number for optimistic concurrency.

parameters.name: pageId
parameters.description: The ID of the page to update.

id.description: The page ID. Must match the path parameter.

title.description: The new or unchanged title for the page.

representation.description: Body format. Use storage for XHTML content.

value.description: The updated body content in storage format (XHTML).

number.description: The new version number (current version + 1). Call Get Page first to obtain the current version.

message.description: Optional change message for this version.

get.description: Returns all Confluence spaces the authenticated user can access. Use to discover space IDs for other operations.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by space type. Options: global, personal.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by space status. Options: current, archived. Default is current.

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: Comma-separated space keys to filter by (e.g., ENG,DOCS).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results per page. Default is 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for pagination obtained from the previous response.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order. Options: id, -id, key, -key, name, -name.

post.description: Creates a new page in a Confluence space. Supports storage format (XHTML) body content.

spaceId.description: The ID of the space to create the page in.

title.description: The title of the new page.

parentId.description: Parent page ID. Creates as a child page if provided.

status.description: Page status. Options: current (published), draft. Default is current.

representation.description: Body format. Use storage for XHTML content.

value.description:
The page body content in storage format (e.g.,

Hello world

).

post.summary: Add a comment to a page
post.description: Creates a footer comment on a Confluence page. Can also reply to an existing comment.

pageId.description: The page to comment on. Required if not replying to an existing comment.

blogPostId.description: The blog post to comment on. Provide instead of Page ID for blog post comments.

parentCommentId.description: Reply to an existing comment by providing its ID.

representation.description: Body format. Use storage for XHTML content.

value.description:
The comment text in storage format (e.g.,

Great page!

).

get.description: Returns details of a specific Confluence space by its ID, including name, key, description, and homepage.

parameters.name: spaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the space to retrieve.

parameters.name: description-format
parameters.description: Format for description. Options: plain, view.

parameters.name: include-icon
parameters.description: Include space icon URL. Default is false.

get.description: Searches Confluence content using Confluence Query Language (CQL). Supports full-text search, space filters, type filters, and date range queries.

parameters.name: cql
parameters.description: Confluence Query Language expression (e.g., type=page AND space=ENG AND text~"onboarding").

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default is 25.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Offset for pagination (0-based). Default is 0.

parameters.name: includeArchivedSpaces
parameters.description: Include content from archived spaces. Default is false.

200.description: Search results matching the CQL query.

get.summary: List blog posts in a space
get.description: Returns blog posts in a specific Confluence space, sorted by creation or modification date.

parameters.name: spaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the space to get blog posts from.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order for blog posts.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status. Options: current, draft, trashed.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results per page. Default is 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for pagination obtained from the previous response.

parameters.name: body-format
parameters.description: Body format. Options: storage, atlas_doc_format.

200.description: A list of blog posts in the space.

parameters.name: blogPostId
